facts.fact: The minister said ONM obtained ISO 9001 (2008 version) certification for its meteorological assistance activities.

facts.fact: The Office National de la Météorologie announced renewal of its ISO 9001:2015 certification, for its aeronautical meteorological services, for the tenth consecutive year after an external audit on 6-8 April 2026.

An ONM official said Algeria daily exchanges millions of data with the WMO network, including from new-generation satellites, which help track clouds and storm zones and make its numerical models finer.
